name: bandgap-loop-smoke
description: Issue #8 schematic-entry smoke test: bandgap_top (bandgap_core + provisional bandgap_amp) nets cleanly and its self-biased servo loop settles to a reference near the classic ~1.2V Brokaw sum at nominal PVT. NOT a spec-conformance claim -- amp sizing/offset budget is #10, startup is #11.
claim: None -- schematic-entry existence proof (issue #8), not evaluated against README.md's ratified target-spec output-reference row (1.20V +/-2% untrimmed). The provisional amp has no offset budget and there is no startup circuit yet, so a spec pass/fail claim would be premature; see design/bandgap_operating_point.md.

vref.description: sanity window for an untrimmed, hand-picked (not offset-budgeted) Brokaw sum -- wider than README.md's ratified +/-2% spec window on purpose; this is an existence-proof bound, not a spec-conformance check (see design/bandgap_operating_point.md)

sns1.description: Q1/Q3 VEB should land near the #4 device-characterization value at ~10uA (0.7227V, record 20260731-030932-8fb0ea6) -- sanity bound, not a spec check

iq_ua.description: total supply current stays in a plausible quiescent range for a 4-branch, ~10uA/branch core plus amp -- sanity bound only, not the README.md Iq<50uA spec line (untrimmed provisional sizing is not expected to hit that yet)
